title: Public-repo guard rejects self-evident zero placeholders in fixtures
description:
Post-wave gate blocker from the wave-4 integration: xrk's scripts/check-public-repo.mjs exits 1 on four findings, all in v2e's test fixtures written in the same wave (cmd/tk/cmd/factory_test.go:288,294 and internal/factory/setup_test.go:32,35). The flagged values are '00000000-0000-...-0000' and 'github_p...0000' — self-evidently synthetic placeholders, not leaked material.

Fix in the GUARD, not by allowlisting the four sites: a value whose payload is entirely a repeated filler character (all zeros, all x) carries no information and must never be a finding, for any detector. That is a general rule that keeps working as fixtures move, whereas four allowlist entries rot immediately and train contributors to add more. Keep the allowlist strictly for genuine historical hits.

Add a guard unit test for the new rule in both directions: an all-zero account id and an all-zero github_pat pass, while a realistic random-looking one still fails.
acceptance_criteria: node scripts/check-public-repo.mjs exits 0 on the integrated tree with no new allowlist entries for these four sites; guard unit tests cover all-zero-passes and realistic-value-still-fails; the four v2e fixtures are unchanged.
